abstract: We report on a malignant germ cell tumor located in the anterior mediastinum. After chemotherapy the tumor was classified as residual teratoma with sarcomatous components. There was extensive hematopoiesis in the tumor tissue. The tumor cells had a modal chromosome number of 76; the only structural abnormality was a deletion of the long arm of chromosome 9. An i(12p) chromosome was lacking in this tumor. Karyotyping of peripheral blood and bone marrow occasionally showed metaphases with numerical and structural abnormalities, probably related to chemotherapy. The patient died within two years after the initial diagnosis, of a poorly differentiated hematopoietic malignancy, probably of myelomonocytic origin, based on morphology and the fact that non-specific esterase activity was demonstrated in the tumor cells. The karyotype of this malignancy was highly abnormal, but unrelated to that of the mediastinal malignant GCT. In this case there is no proof that the secondary malignancy was derived from the primary mediastinal malignant GCT. In view of the multiple aneuploid stem lines in the primary tumor, this possibility cannot be dismissed either.
abstract_ja: 前縦隔に生じた悪性胚細胞腫瘍を報告する。化学療法後、腫瘍は肉腫様成分を伴う残存奇形腫と分類され、腫瘍組織内に広範な造血活性がみられた。腫瘍細胞の染色体モード数は76で、唯一の構造異常は長腕9番染色体の欠失であった。i(12p)染色体はこの腫瘍には認められなかった。末梢血および骨髄の核型分析では、化学療法によると思われる数的・構造的異常を持つ中期像が時折認められた。患者は初診から2年以内に、形態学的所見と腫瘍細胞の非特異的エステラーゼ活性の証明から骨髄単球性由来と考えられる低分化造血器悪性腫瘍により死亡した。この悪性腫瘍の核型は著しく異常で、原発性悪性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の核型とは無関係であった。本症例では、二次性悪性腫瘍が原発性縦隔悪性胚細胞腫瘍に由来したという証拠はない。原発腫瘍に多数の異数性幹細胞系が存在することを考えると、この可能性も否定できない。
